[LSER.6.11.3] **A series read takes no window argument.** A series
aggregation call's arguments are its cursor, and for `count_of` and `contains`
the value ([LSER.6.5]); nothing else. The window a read sees is the window of the
declaration [LSER.6.11.1] resolves it to, and where one slot declares an
aggregation on more than one line, the cursor's label is what chooses between
them. The compiler **must** refuse any further argument, a duration or any
other value, with `DS_VALIDATE_BAD_ARITY` ([LEXP.3.1]).
